mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_topic (student_id, topic_id, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{student.id}, #{topic.id}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.description, t.requirements, st.status, t.teacher_id, t.max_students, u.realname, u.email, u.phone FROM student_topic st JOIN topic t ON st.topic_id = t.id JOIN user u ON t.teacher_id = u.id WHERE st.student_id = #{id};

SELECT st.id, t.id, t.title, t.description, t.requirements, t.max_students, st.create_time, st.status, u.realname FROM topic t JOIN student_topic st ON t.id = st.topic_id JOIN user u ON st.student_id = u.id WHERE t.teacher_id = #{id};
SELECT t.id AS topic_id, t.max_students, COUNT(st.topic_id) AS student_count FROM topic t LEFT JOIN student_topic st ON t.id = st.topic_id WHERE t.id = #{topicId} GROUP BY t.id, t.max_students;
